examples.sql: SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP('29 JUN 2022'), TO_TIMESTAMP('2022 Jun 29','YYYY MON DD'), TO_TIMESTAMP('JUNE 29, 2022','month dd, YYYY'), TO_TIMESTAMP('2022***06***29','YYYY***MM***DD'), TO_TIMESTAMP('06/29/2022','MM/DD/YYYY'), TO_TIMESTAMP('29/6/2022','DD/MM/YYYY')
